title: Ensure localization changes only “Hey” in “Hey Siri”

statement.en: In localized “Hey Siri,” ensure only the word “Hey” is translated.
statement.ja: localized「Hey Siri」では「Hey」だけをtranslateする。

conditions: Use the acceptable translation listed by Apple for the target locale.
